enum hb_trigger_type_t

Types of triggers that can initiate a heartbeat.

Values:

enumerator HB_TRIGGER_RELAY

Triggered by relay action.

enumerator HB_TRIGGER_PROXY

Triggered by proxy initiation.

enumerator HB_TRIGGER_FN

Triggered by friend node actions.

enumerator HB_TRIGGER_LPN

Triggered by low power node interactions.

enumerator HB_TRIGGER_ALL

Triggered by all mechanisms collectively.

enum hb_data_type_t

Types of heartbeat data events.

Values:

enumerator HB_DATA_PUB_TIMER_STATE

Data type for publish timer state. The structure of callback data is hb_data_timer_state_t.

enumerator HB_DATA_SUB_TIMER_STATE

Data type for subscribe timer state. The structure of callback data is hb_data_timer_state_t.

enumerator HB_DATA_PUB_COUNT_UPDATE

Data type for publish count update. The structure of callback data is hb_data_pub_count_update_t.

enumerator HB_DATA_SUB_PERIOD_UPDATE

Data type for subscribe period update. The structure of callback data is hb_data_sub_period_update_t.

enumerator HB_DATA_SUB_RECEIVE

Data type for subscription data received. The structure of callback data is hb_data_sub_receive_t.

struct hb_pub_t

Configuration for heartbeat publishing.

Public Members

uint16_t dst

Publish destination address.

uint16_t count

Publish count, range: 0-0xFFFF (0 means no periodic sending, 0xFFFF means indefinitely sending).

uint16_t period

Period for sending heartbeat messages, range: 0-0xFFFF, unit: seconds.

uint8_t ttl

Time to Live value for heartbeat messages.

hb_pub_features_t features

Features triggering heartbeat sending.

uint16_t net_key_index

Network key index used for publishing.

struct hb_sub_t

Configuration for processing heartbeat subscriptions.

Public Members

uint16_t src

Source address for processing heartbeat messages.

uint16_t dst

Destination address for heartbeat messages.

uint16_t period

Period for processing heartbeat messages, 0 means not processed.

uint16_t count

Number of heartbeat messages received. 0xFFFF means over 0xFFFE messages received.

uint8_t min_hops

Minimum hops encountered in received heartbeat messages.

uint8_t max_hops

Maximum hops encountered in received heartbeat messages.
